msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia sederias-natalia-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a red hand-embroidered silk manila shawl with a long fringe from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia sederias-natalia-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a red hand-embroidered silk manila shawl from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia sederias-natalia-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a blue printed shawl with a long fringe on a mannequin from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia sederias-natalia-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a red and black checked traditional vest from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia sederias-natalia-33.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of traditional embroidered garters with tassels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
